method: 600px contact sheets for all 169; 1568px views of all 45 selected frames and 24 contenders; 100% crops on 8 subjects. Instagram: nothing from this trip has been posted.

frames.critique: Ulsanbawi's granite from below, pines at its foot. A strong opener: it says where we are.
The stairs under a lone pine. Graphic and specific to the climb.
Your pick for the ridge. Clean and strong.
Cloud on the ridge with climbers on the stairs. Holds its 5 at 100%.
The railing view of the cloud; a real variation of 3468 but weaker.
Pine branches over the autumn valley. Your 3 holds: lovely layers, but the valley is a flat green-orange texture without a point.
Up a star. At full size: the granite wall at left, red maples, a dead tree, then the whole Seoraksan range under cloud. The best wide frame of the day; it could open the page.
Your pick, the tree on the cliff.
A hiker going down into the colour; the handover to the maples.
Not selected. Heundeulbawi, the rocking rock, looks like an animal head against the valley. Fun and specific; a candidate if the chapter wants a lighter note.
The beach with a lone figure in pink and the Ferris wheel skyline under storm cloud. Better than its 2 at full size: the figure gives scale and mood.
Rocks and surf with the skyline; teal sea, moody. Overlaps 3359.
Waves on the rocks under the Lotte Resort. Good surf, the hotel is a big block.
The beach at night in the rain, people with umbrellas. Atmospheric; the rain is part of it.

frames.technical: lamp-post arms intrude at both bottom corners
frames.critique: The cable car against the peaks; a good establishing frame, the two railing arms are a blemish.

frames.technical: cable car glass: smudges and reflections across the left half
frames.critique: Disqualifying: the glass is the photo.
Your pick: your reflection in the window. The glass is the point here.

frames.technical: heavy glass reflections across the left third and a flare patch on the cliff, visible at display size
frames.critique: On the site now. The view down to Sokcho and the sea is excellent, but the cable car window is all over it. Under our rules this is close to disqualifying; flagged for your call.
People on the Gwongeumseong rock.
Layered autumn ridges.
People on the rock, the valley below.
Ridges in raking light.
Up a star. Backlit maples against blue sky, glowing orange; the clearest 'maple season' frame and the right opener for the chapter.
Colour on the descent.
Your site pick; holds.
Your site pick.
Colour run; close to 3497 and 3503.
Your site pick: pines framing the peaks.
Colour run.
The orange canopy from below; good, but 3422 does it better and the two read as twins.
Up a star. The Sinheungsa gable from below: dragons, dancheong, a crane plaque. A strong looking-up frame, and it closes the maples well.
Dropped. The hall's eaves with the dragon heads and the name board, side-on. As strong as 3520; the two would make a fine pair.
Biseondae under a flat white sky; the sky takes a third and gives nothing.
The cliff with pines dissolving into cloud. One of the best frames of the day.
Landscape version of 3545; same cliff, same cloud. A near-twin.
Down a star. The gorge from above with the river and a walkway: good, but busy, and at full size the walkway and people draw the eye from the river.
Your site pick; up a star. Pinkish granite towers against drifting cloud, a single red maple. Stronger than 3546 for the same idea.
Your pick; the misty spire.
The cliff framing a peak in cloud; holds.
Red ivy against the mist; your 3 holds.
The wet metal stairs down into the gorge in fog. Says 'the way down' well.
The stream with Ulsanbawi on the ridge in sun. Good, but it's the morning and Ulsanbawi; it belongs closer to the start than in Waterfalls.
The cascade framed by a maple branch, long exposure. Holds.
Your site pick: the boulder river under the misty peak.
Not selected: slick granite slabs and the stream in colour. Close to 3591.
The suspension bridge over the S-curve fall, a hiker in red. Holds.
Portrait twin of 3612; the landscape is better.
Biryong falls into the green pool. Clean but plain.
Towangseong falls with a dead tree in the foreground; the tree is a good layer.
Your pick: Towangseong with a pine. Near-twin of 3627; both stay only if you want two views of the same fall.
